mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where RSAFS shows a sustained 3-month increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tight labor market, which leads to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to decline.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO YoY < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 3% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is above 2.5% YoY, the combination signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 3% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When Housing Starts (HOUST) increase by more than 10% YoY and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) increase by more than 5% YoY, it signals strong demand, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST YoY > 10% and RSAFS YoY > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, which leads to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 300,000.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% YoY signals a potential supply-side slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO YoY < -1% during a late-cycle expansion.
